first ever wheat paste, it's outside of ocad, was way less difficult than i played it out in my head but i was nervous the whooooole time. i printed 2 24x36 posters and made a shitty paste following a reddit tutorial. i think i needed to let the paste cool for longer next time because it was slipping off the paper and was more difficult to use. i enjoy walking past it and i wonder if the person on the card (or someone who knows them) will ever see it and how strange of a feeling it would be to have your name blown up on a wall somewhere. even if it is technically okay because you put your name on this socially acceptable format where your name can travel (and you hope it would) anywhere infinitely. when i think about that perspective it feels quite invasive. oops. i like it though.
